note: Chinese place words the World Bank's Chinese country list (wb-countries-zh.json) does not hold. aliases: the common short name of a country whose registry name is the long form (韩国 for 大韩民国), each as an iso2 code with its source. groups: country groups by year; a group word reads as the members of the period that holds the year the question names, or of the latest period when it names none. Members are iso2 codes of countries only (the EU and the African Union, members of the G20, are not countries and are not listed).

periods.source: First BRIC summit, Yekaterinburg, 16 June 2009 (Joint Statement of the BRIC Countries' Leaders)
South Africa admitted 24 December 2010, first summit as a member Sanya, 14 April 2011 (Sanya Declaration)
Johannesburg II Declaration, 24 August 2023: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the UAE members from 1 January 2024 (Saudi Arabia, invited, has not confirmed and is not listed)
Brazil's BRICS presidency (brics.br, members page), 6 January 2025: Indonesia a full member
ASEAN Declaration (Bangkok Declaration), 8 August 1967 (asean.org, ASEAN Member States)
Brunei Darussalam joined 7 January 1984 (asean.org, ASEAN Member States)
Viet Nam joined 28 July 1995 (asean.org, ASEAN Member States)
Lao PDR and Myanmar joined 23 July 1997 (asean.org, ASEAN Member States)
Cambodia joined 30 April 1999 (asean.org, ASEAN Member States)
Timor-Leste admitted at the 47th ASEAN Summit, Kuala Lumpur, 26 October 2025 (asean.org, ASEAN Member States)
Canada joined at the San Juan summit, 27-28 June 1976 (Government of Canada, About the G7, international.gc.ca)
G20 founded at the finance ministers' meeting, Berlin, 15-16 December 1999 (g20.org, About G20: 19 countries, the EU and, since 9 September 2023, the African Union)
